tobacco.note: Tobacco shall not be used as an ingredient in any food product.
tobacco.regulation: FSSAI Prohibition and Restriction on Sales Regulations, 2011 — Reg. 2.3.4

nicotine.note: Nicotine shall not be used as an ingredient in any food product.
nicotine.regulation: FSSAI Prohibition and Restriction on Sales Regulations, 2011 — Reg. 2.3.4

kesari.note: Kesari gram/dal (Lathyrus sativus) and its products/mixtures are restricted; incidental occurrence in grams/pulses capped at 2%.
kesari.regulation: FSSAI Prohibition and Restriction on Sales Regulations, 2011 — Reg. 2.2.1, 2.2.2

lathyrus.note: Lathyrus sativus (kesari) and its products/mixtures are restricted; incidental occurrence in grams/pulses capped at 2%.
lathyrus.regulation: FSSAI Prohibition and Restriction on Sales Regulations, 2011 — Reg. 2.2.1, 2.2.2

mineral oil.note: Food articles coated with mineral oil are prohibited, except where specifically permitted under FSSAI standards.
mineral oil.regulation: FSSAI Prohibition and Restriction on Sales Regulations, 2011 — Reg. 2.3.1

carbide.note: Use of carbide gas (calcium carbide/acetylene) for artificial ripening of fruit is prohibited.
carbide.regulation: FSSAI Prohibition and Restriction on Sales Regulations, 2011 — Reg. 2.3.5
